samples.name: Camel Pebbled Leather Tote
samples.description:
Soft pebbled leather in a warm camel with darker stitched handles. Roomy enough for a laptop, a water bottle and everything else, with an inside zip pocket for keys.

Shoulder-length handles, magnetic snap top.

samples.name: Oatmeal Tweed Satchel
samples.description:
Woven oatmeal tweed with black leather handles and gold hardware. Carry it by the handles or clip on the long strap and wear it crossbody.

Structured shape that stands on its own.

samples.name: Everyday Black Canvas Tote
samples.description:
The tote you'll grab every single day. Sturdy black canvas, long handles and room for groceries, gym clothes or a weekend away.

Washes up easy.

samples.name: Blush Scalloped Flap Bag
samples.description:
Blush faux leather with a scalloped flap and a black satin scarf tied on the handle. Dressy enough for church, easy enough for errands.

Top handle plus an adjustable crossbody strap.

samples.name: Cognac Chain Shoulder Bag
samples.description:
A little '90s shoulder bag in rich cognac with a leather-woven chain strap and a silk scarf accent.

Fits your phone, wallet, keys and lipstick.

samples.name: Rust Leather Buckle Messenger
samples.description:
Rust leather messenger with chocolate buckle straps and brass rings. Gets better with every wear.

Wide adjustable strap, front flap with two magnetic buckles.

samples.name: Cherry Red Dome Satchel
samples.description:
Glossy textured cherry red in a classic dome shape with a two-way zip. A pop of color for any outfit.

Two top handles, gold feet on the bottom.

samples.name: Black Embossed Dome Satchel
samples.description:
The same classic dome satchel in black, with a wavy embossed finish that hides scuffs. Goes with everything.

Two-way zip, top handles, inside pocket.

samples.name: Gold Swirl Hard-Shell Clutch
samples.description:
Hard-shell evening clutch with a gold and pewter swirl pattern and a crystal clasp. Wedding guest ready.

Tuck-away chain strap inside.

samples.name: Ivory Pleated Frame Clutch
samples.description:
Soft ivory pleats on a silver frame with a slim chain strap. Pretty for a bride, a shower or a night out.

Kiss-lock close.

samples.name: Champagne Crystal Evening Clutch
samples.description:
Covered in champagne crystals with a gold frame and jeweled clasp. It catches every light in the room.

Comes with a chain strap.
